name: Virtual High School (VHS)

geo.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocode of the official address (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), 2026-10-30 — office match 'Virtual High School' (administrative office, not a campus)

description: Fully online private secondary school, inspected by the Ontario ministry since 2001 (BSID 665681), selling self-paced OSSD credit courses year-round to students anywhere.

attributes.philosophy: Self-paced: students choose when and where to study, when to submit and when to write final exams; certified teachers; free online tutoring.

legal_status.label: Private school operating under a Notice of Intention to Operate (Education Act s.16, Ontario) — online only

advantages: Flexible, self-paced OSSD credits from anywhere — useful for travelling or home-educating families
limitations: Conventional curriculum delivered online; flexibility is in pace, not content
Per-course prices not published on pages read
attributes.qualifying_reason: In scope as a private online school and inspected (Ontario list no. 665681), but course fees with a school year were not found on the official site (third-party listings only), and the model is conventional content at flexible pace.

sources.title: Private school contact information (CSV, resource last modified 2026-10-22)

verification.notes: Status verified; fees not found on the official site.
